title: Harnessing the Reasoning Economy: A Survey of Efficient Reasoning for Large Language Models
best_for_zh: 研究长推理过程、测试时预算或推理效率的读者。
one_line: A 2025 survey of how to reduce redundant reasoning without confusing fewer tokens with better reasoning.
讨论如何减少冗长推理，同时不把少输出误当成更会推理的 2025 综述。
why: It gives students a disciplined way to compare answer quality against trace length, time, and computation.
inclusion_reason: A 2025 survey from CUHK, HKU, Princeton, and UIUC collaborators that treats reasoning traces as both useful evidence and a finite compute resource.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long reasoning can solve difficult tasks, but it can also repeat definitions, explore useless branches, and spend thousands of tokens on an easy question. This survey studies that tension. It asks how to preserve the useful part of deliberate reasoning while reducing avoidable computation. The data object is usually a prompt, an explicit reasoning trace, a final answer, and measurements such as length, latency, or cost. The important boundary is that a shorter answer is not automatically a better reasoning process.
长推理能解决难题，但也可能反复解释定义、探索无用分支，或在简单问题上花掉数千 token。这篇综述研究的就是这个张力：怎样保留深思熟虑中有用的部分，同时减少可避免的计算？数据对象通常包括提示、显式推理过程、最终答案，以及长度、延迟或成本等测量。关键边界是：输出更短，不等于推理更好。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper frames efficient reasoning as a joint objective rather than a compression contest. A method should be compared on both task quality and resource use. It groups work that changes model behavior, changes how much computation is allocated to an input, or changes how candidate reasoning paths are selected. This lets readers ask a fair question: did the system become efficient because it learned a cleaner procedure, because it stopped early, or because the evaluation no longer exposed difficult cases?
论文把高效推理看作联合目标，而不是压缩比赛。一个方法应同时比较任务质量和资源消耗。它归纳三类工作：改变模型行为、改变每个输入分配多少计算，或改变如何选择候选推理路径。这使读者能提出公平问题：系统变高效，是因为学会了更干净的过程，因为提前停止，还是因为评测不再暴露困难样例？

title: Method
方法
html: As a survey, the method is a taxonomy of existing interventions. For every cited technique, record four items: the task input, the reasoning representation, the rule that allocates or removes computation, and the score used to judge the result. Some approaches shorten explicit chains; others store more work in hidden states; still others choose different budgets for different questions. A reproducible comparison must state decoding settings, model size, hardware or serving conditions, and whether correctness is checked before or after truncation.
作为综述，它的方法是对已有干预手段做分类。对每项被引用技术，都记录四件事：任务输入、推理表示、分配或删减计算的规则，以及判定结果的分数。有的方法缩短显式过程，有的方法把更多工作放进隐藏状态，还有的方法为不同问题选择不同预算。可复现的比较必须写清解码设置、模型规模、硬件或服务条件，以及正确性是在截断前还是截断后检查。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The evidence is a structured view of a young literature, not a claim that one efficiency trick wins everywhere. The official abstract emphasizes regulating inefficient behavior and improving test-time use. Results in this area are especially sensitive to the task mix: a fixed short budget can look excellent on routine items and fail on the few questions that need exploration. Read reported averages together with difficulty buckets, failure examples, accuracy, trace length, latency, and compute whenever they are available.
它提供的是对新兴文献的结构化视图，而不是宣称某个效率技巧在所有地方都最好。官方摘要强调调节低效行为和改进测试时使用。这个方向的结果特别依赖任务构成：固定的短预算在常规题上可能很好，却会在少数需要探索的问题上失败。阅读平均分时，应尽量同时看难度分桶、失败案例、准确率、过程长度、延迟和计算量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier efficiency work often treated language-model serving as the main target. This survey focuses on a different bottleneck: the variable, explicit reasoning trajectory of recent reasoning models. It connects behavior such as repetition and over-analysis to choices about training signals and test-time allocation. The new contribution is a vocabulary for judging trade-offs. It does not show that all long reasoning is wasteful; on hard tasks, a longer search may be exactly the evidence a correct answer requires.
较早的效率研究常把语言模型服务本身作为主要目标。这篇综述关注另一个瓶颈：新型推理模型可变而显式的推理轨迹。它把重复、过度分析等行为同训练信号和测试时分配选择联系起来。新贡献是一套判断取舍的词汇。它并不证明所有长推理都是浪费；在难题上，更长的搜索可能正是正确答案所需的证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: There is no universal unit for “efficient reasoning.” Tokens, wall-clock time, energy, cost, answer quality, and explanation quality can move in different directions. Hidden reasoning can reduce visible length while making inspection harder. A system that saves compute on a static benchmark may not save it in an interactive setting with tool delays. Use the taxonomy to locate candidate methods, but return to primary papers for their budget rule and the cases where shortening changed the answer.
“高效推理”没有通用单位。token、实际时间、能耗、成本、答案质量和解释质量可能朝不同方向变化。隐藏推理能减少可见长度，却可能让检查更困难。一个系统在静态基准上节省计算，不代表它在带工具延迟的交互环境中也节省。可先用分类找到候选方法，再回到原始论文查看预算规则，以及缩短过程后答案改变的案例。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey when you have a trace-producing model and a real budget. First define what must not get worse: final correctness, verified intermediate steps, robustness, or user-visible latency. Then decide whether an input should receive a fixed budget, an adaptive budget, or a second-pass check. The survey helps students reject a common mistake: optimizing the mean trace length before measuring whether the removed steps occur on easy repetition or on the rare reasoning move that prevents an error.
当你有一个会产出推理过程的模型，也有真实预算时，可用这篇综述。先定义什么不能变差：最终正确性、可验证的中间步骤、鲁棒性，还是用户可见延迟；再决定输入应使用固定预算、自适应预算，还是二次检查。它能帮助学生避开常见错误：先优化平均过程长度，却没有测量删掉的是简单重复，还是少见但能避免错误的关键推理动作。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the taxonomy with a ledger. For each method, write one row: quality signal, cost signal, intervention point, and hardest observed failure. Keep accuracy and cost in separate columns until the end; this prevents a favorable aggregate from hiding a sharp reliability loss. The most transferable lesson is not “make chains shorter.” It is “make computation conditional on evidence of need,” then prove that the decision rule still protects the cases that require deliberate reasoning.
建议带着一张账本读分类。对每个方法写一行：质量信号、成本信号、干预位置和观察到的最难失败。直到最后都把准确率和成本分列，避免漂亮的聚合数掩盖严重的可靠性下降。最可迁移的结论不是“让过程更短”，而是“让计算随需要的证据而变化”，再证明这个决策规则仍保护那些确实需要深思的问题。
